full_judgment: 3. The plaintiffs' case, in brief, is that Dabiruddin Ahamed Chowdhury was the original landlord of the suit property, who granted pattan to Bazru Mahmud, predecessor of the plaintiffs; that the suit property was wrongly recorded in the names of other persons who have no interest in the suit property. Hence the suit.
